title: Confirm alert will sometimes not snooze alert
symptom: Every now and then the user cannot confirm an alert and it reappears every minute. This also happens with snooze from the Pebble. The user needs to confirm it several times before it stays quiet until the snooze time is done.
fix: The issue seems to be fixed after trying the latest nightly version, although it occurred once again after two days.
evidence_quote: The issue seems to be fixed. although it didn't occur on every alarm, I tried it for 2 days now and it happened once again.
